integrity: The theorem is proved for arbitrary complex Hilbert dimension at least two by spectral functional calculus and rank-one reduction. Numerical checks supplement, and do not replace, the proof. No external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp claim is restricted to a positive first factor and a square-zero second factor. It is an exact supremum, potentially unattained for continuous spectral endpoints. Priority risk from specialized earlier operator-product inequalities remains; independent audit has not been performed.
title: A sharp spectral-band numerical-radius law for square-zero factors
